Usage: deckent <command> [options]
Getting started:
  terminal    Open the interactive terminal
  init        Set up an installation
Observe:
  monitor     Watch installations and work
  workers     List or watch workers
Execute work:
  run         Create and manage Runs
  task        Execute, evaluate and deliver Tasks
  pool        Inspect, hold or resume a pool
  decide      Prepare, ask and record advisory decisions
Models:
  models      Inspect and manage models
Approvals:
  approval    Inspect and decide approval requests
  policy      Inspect policy and standing grants
Setup / Maintenance:
  backup      Create, verify and restore recovery sets
  identity    Identity profiles and draft previews
  config      Inspect and change configuration
  mcp         Manage MCP servers
  secret      Manage stored secrets
  toolchains  Check or update worker toolchains
  doctor      Check installation health
Global options: --json  --lang en|tr  --no-color
Examples: deckent doctor; deckent config get
Details: deckent <command> --help; developer commands: deckent --help --all
No arguments on a terminal opens the interactive session. --version: version.
